# Shiva Subramaniyam — Full Stack Developer & Web3 Builder

I build Web3 identity tools, real-time canvas editors, and production APIs. My focus is on solving real problems with modern web technologies.

## Key Projects

### SSI Platform (TrustGrid)
Self-sovereign identity platform with reusable digital credential templates. Built the template preview library for enterprise SSI integration.

### Custom Canvas Editor (Fabric.js)
Dynamic browser-based design tool with drag-and-drop, layer management, and export — all client-side. Built with Fabric.js and React.

### E-Commerce Backend API
Production-ready Node.js API with JWT auth, PostgreSQL + Prisma ORM, role-based access control, product management, and order flow.

### SynQ Social
Decentralized social network platform for privacy-first content sharing. Built automation pipelines for content verification.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Fabric.js, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, JWT
- **Web3:** IPFS, WebRTC, Self-Sovereign Identity
- **Tools:** Git, Figma, Postman, Puppeteer, Vercel
